title: Seal eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water splash / body water -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='38' ry='10' fill='#2f6fb0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='30' ry='7' fill='#4f9fe0'/>
  <!-- seal body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='26' ry='17' fill='#8fc6d8'/>
  <!-- belly lighter -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='18' ry='11' fill='#d8eef5'/>
  <!-- flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='64' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#6fb0c8' transform='rotate(-20 24 64)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='64' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#6fb0c8' transform='rotate(20 76 64)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='16' fill='#9fd0e0'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#c8e8f2'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#1b1b3a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#1b1b3a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#2b2b50'/>
  <!-- mouth open -->
  <path d='M44 47 Q50 53 56 47 Q50 50 44 47 Z' fill='#c05070'/>
  <!-- fish snack -->
  <g transform='rotate(-15 66 50)'>
    <ellipse cx='66' cy='50' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#ffb347'/>
    <path d='M74 50 L82 44 L82 56 Z' fill='#ff9a2e'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='48' r='1.3' fill='#3a2a10'/>
    <!-- stripes -->
    <path d='M64 46 L66 54' stroke='#e07a1c' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M68 45 L70 54' stroke='#e07a1c' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M60 44 L68 42' stroke='#c8e8f2' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 46 L68 47' stroke='#c8e8f2' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 44 L32 42' stroke='#c8e8f2' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 46 L32 47' stroke='#c8e8f2' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='24' r='2' fill='#7fd0ff'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='18' r='1.4' fill='#7fd0ff'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='1.6' fill='#7fd0ff'/>
</svg>
